brief: The canvas presents a deep, stylized isometric cross-section view into a stack of industrial server racks. The structure is rendered in cool, muted metallic tones, giving the impression of complex depth. Glowing, intricate circuit tracings illuminate the metallic surfaces, pulsating with rhythmic, electric pulses. Embedded within these glowing lines are visible, luminous streams of data flow. These volumetric lines constantly pulse and traverse the entire structure, creating the impression of enormous, living digital data moving through the machine.
